title: Cross-Modality Investigation on WESAD Stress Classification
abstract: arXiv:2502.18733v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep learning's growing prevalence has driven its widespread use in healthcare, where AI and sensor advancements enhance diagnosis, treatment, and monitoring. In mobile health, AI-powered tools enable early diagnosis and continuous monitoring of conditions like stress. Wearable technologies and multimodal physiological data have made stress detection increasingly viable, but model efficacy depends on data quality, quantity, and modality. This study develops transformer models for stress detection using the WESAD dataset, training on electrocardiograms (ECG), electrodermal activity (EDA), electromyography (EMG), respiration rate (RESP), temperature (TEMP), and 3-axis accelerometer (ACC) signals. translated_title: WESAD压力分类的跨模态研究
translated_abstract: 深度学习的日益普及推动了其在医疗保健领域的广泛应用，人工智能和传感器技术的进步提升了诊断、治疗和监测的水平。在移动健康领域，AI驱动的工具能够实现压力等健康状况的早期诊断和持续监测。可穿戴技术和多模态生理数据使得压力检测越来越可行，但模型的效果取决于数据的质量、数量和模态。本研究基于WESAD数据集开发了用于压力检测的Transformer模型，在心电图（ECG）、皮肤电活动（EDA）、肌电图（EMG）、呼吸频率（RESP）、体温（TEMP）和三轴加速度计（ACC）信号上进行训练。结果证明了单模态Transformer在分析生理信号方面的有效性，实现了最先进的性能，在压力分类任务上准确率、精确率和召回率达到99.73%至99.95%。
tldr: 本研究基于WESAD数据集开发单模态Transformer模型，利用ECG、EDA、EMG等多种生理信号进行压力检测，实现了99.73%至99.95%的最先进分类性能。
en_tdlr: This study develops single-modality transformer models for stress detection on the WESAD dataset using physiological signals (ECG, EDA, EMG, RESP, TEMP, ACC), achieving state-of-the-art performance with accuracy, precision, and recall ranging from 99.73% to 99.95%.
